_meta.purpose: Maps each NIS2 control template to the src/data/libraries/nis2-2022.yaml node that grounds its authored tasks.
_meta.why: The template's own `requirements` code (Art.21(2)(a)) and the library's ref_id (NIS2-RM) are different naming schemes, so nothing joined them and 0 of 20 resolved. This map is the join, in data, so a guardrail can check it. Derived from the '(Paraphrase — Art. …)' citation each library node carries in its own description, not from judgement: 11 match on the exact article, and Art.20 / Art.23 match at article level because the library carries one node for each of those whole articles.

unmapped._why: These five carry no library node, and that is the library being CORRECT rather than incomplete: it covers entity-facing obligations and these articles are not. They are NOT deleted and NOT left blank — each is RESCOPED as a determination control, whose authored tasks are about establishing whether the article reaches this entity and recording the outcome with its basis. That is a real, finishable, evidence-producing obligation, where 'implement Article 7' is not. Deleting them instead would drop five genuine directive articles from coverage and leave a future NIS2 assessment unable to show it had considered them.
unmapped.NIS2-NS2: Art.7(1) — national cybersecurity strategy. Binds MEMBER STATES. Rescoped to identifying the competent authority and CSIRT per jurisdiction, which the Art.23 reporting duties depend on.
unmapped.NIS2-ST: Art.25 — standards and technical specifications. Binds Member States and ENISA, who promote their use. Rescoped to recording which standards the entity relies on to evidence its Art.21 measures.
unmapped.NIS2-CE: Art.24(1) — certification schemes. Permissive: a Member State MAY require certified products. Rescoped to determining whether such a requirement was in fact made where the entity operates.
unmapped.NIS2-DN: Art.28(1) — domain registration data. Applies to TLD registries and DNS providers only. Rescoped so the first task is determining whether the entity is one; a recorded "no" is a complete outcome.
unmapped.NIS2-IS: Art.29(1) — information sharing. Voluntary: entities MAY exchange information. Rescoped to recording the participation decision, where deciding not to participate is fully compliant.
